description: Official Derrick on-demand runner (ODR) image for remote build and deploy operations.
aboutText:
## Derrick ODR

On-demand runner image for [Derrick](https://github.com/nomatronio/derrick). Pair with the server image `public.ecr.aws/nomatronio/derrick`.

- Source: https://github.com/nomatronio/derrick
- Server image: https://gallery.ecr.aws/nomatronio/derrick
usageText:
## Pull

```bash
docker pull public.ecr.aws/nomatronio/derrick-odr:latest
```

## Custom runner base

```dockerfile
FROM public.ecr.aws/nomatronio/derrick-odr:latest
```
